ruleExplore.author: @js:result.artistName||result.subName||''
ruleExplore.kind: @js:(function(){var tag=result.tag||result.category||'';var map={'TRENDING_MUSIC':'热门','V-POP':'越南流行','C-POP':'华语','K-POP':'韩语','US-UK':'欧美','YOUTUBE_GLOBAL':'YouTube','V-REMIX_TOP_50':'Remix','V-RAP_TOP_50':'说唱','V-INDIE_TOP_50':'独立','BILLBOARD_GLOBAL':'Billboard','KOREA_MELON':'Melon','EDM_TOP_50':'电音'};return map[tag]||result.type||'';})()

ruleToc.chapterList: @js:(function(){var d=JSON.parse(result);if(!d||!d.data)return[];var dd=d.data;if(dd.streamURL){var k=dd.key||'';if(!k)return[];var nm=dd.name||'Track';var ar=dd.artistName||'';return[{name:nm+(ar?' - '+ar:''),url:'https://graph.nct.vn/api/v1/song/detail/'+k}];}var list=dd.listSong||dd.items||[];var out=[];var seen={};for(var i=0;i<list.length;i++){var it=list[i]||{};var k2=it.key||'';if(!k2||seen[k2])continue;seen[k2]=1;var nm2=it.name||('Track '+(i+1));var ar2=it.artistName||'';var du=it.duration||0;var dur=du?(' ['+Math.floor(du/60)+':'+(du%60<10?'0':'')+du%60+']'):'';out.push({name:(i+1)+'. '+nm2+(ar2?' - '+ar2:'')+dur,url:'https://graph.nct.vn/api/v1/song/detail/'+k2});}return out;})()
